name: ML-Bench
description: A benchmark rooted in real-world programming applications that evaluates large language models and AI agents on repository-scale machine learning tasks, focusing on code understanding, generation, and execution within complex multi-file repositories.
reputation: A newer repository-scale ML coding benchmark that has been used to evaluate agentic code understanding and execution on realistic multi-file machine learning projects.
notes: Includes two evaluation setups: ML-LLM-Bench for text-to-code conversion and ML-Agent-Bench for autonomous agent task execution in a Linux sandbox.
